title: BIOLOG cursor-paginated list response
description: ADR-0004 Decision 5.1. Cursor pagination is the default; the cursor is opaque and a client must not construct or parse it. Chosen over offset pagination, which degrades at the platform's stated capacity baseline (500k-2M identities per tenant).

next_cursor.description: Opaque continuation token, or null when there is no further page. Never parsed or constructed by a client.

total_count.description: Optional. Present only when this specific query makes counting cheap; not a general requirement.
